title: Stoolball
tagline: Defend the board. Run for it.
description: The village bat-and-board game of Sussex. Slide the paddle to meet the ball, choose Block, Drive or Lift and tap as the ring closes, then run or hold. Bat and bowl a match against three levels of opponent, play a quick knock or the daily knock, and let Watch & Learn explain every choice.
howToPlay: Drag sideways on the pitch to slide the paddle into the ball's line.
Tap Block, Drive or Lift as the ring closes on the paddle.
The part of the paddle the ball meets sets the direction: aim for a gap on the field map.
Tap RUN when the gauge is green; tap again to turn back.
In the second innings you bowl: drag the aim marker, choose pace and bounce, set the field and press Bowl.
